name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen2.5-72B for EXCAVA. It’s the cheapest 128K-context model with proven performance on long-context tasks, giving us more tokens per dollar than any rival. The trade-off is accepting its slightly lower raw speed—irrelevant for our use case—since the cost savings let us run more experiments.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B’s 128K claim is vendor marketing—our tests show it collapses past 32K, so the "long-context" benefit is a lie. Swap to Mistral Large 3 with its verified 128K (single internal test, but at least it’s not a scam) and benchmark both on our actual 64K tasks; if Mistral’s speed loss is under 10%, it’s the safer bet.
